references.text: Jesus speaks about those who endure to the end will be saved, which is similar to the encouragement about perseverance in Mark 13:13.
Jesus predicts persecution and hatred toward his disciples because of his name, parallel to what is mentioned in Mark 13:13.
Luke gives a similar warning about persecution for Jesus' name and the importance of endurance.
Isaiah speaks about being hated and cast out for the Lord's name, which reflects the theme in Mark 13:13.
Jeremiah refers to persecution due to faithfulness to God, which is relevant to being hated for Jesus' name in Mark 13:13.
The author of Hebrews encourages endurance under persecution, which resonates with the message in Mark 13:13.
Paul says that all who want to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted, which corresponds with the theme of persecution in Mark 13:13.
